name: Ask User Question
description: Ask the user multiple-choice questions and wait for the answer.

function.name: ask_user_question
function.description: Ask the user 1-4 multiple-choice questions during your turn and wait for their answer. Use it only when blocked on a decision that is the user's to make (ambiguous requirement, choice between approaches, preference); never for things you can decide or look up. The user can always pick 'Other', so do not add an 'Other' option. If one option is your recommendation, put it first with recommended: true. If status is 'dismissed' the user closed the card: do not assume answers. Web chat and Telegram only: if it returns status 'unavailable', do not call it again; ask in plain text.

question.description: The complete question, ending with a question mark.

header.description: Very short label shown as a chip (max 12 chars), e.g. 'Database'.

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting more than one option. Default false.

options.description: 2-4 distinct choices. Do not include an 'Other' option; it is added automatically.

label.description: Short display text for the choice (1-5 words).

description.description: What this choice means or its trade-offs.

recommended.description: Optional. true marks this option as your recommendation (at most one per single-choice question). Do not write '(Recommended)' in the label.
